scope.intended_use: Conceal a measured removable succulent nursery pot inside an original stylised curled-cat body while keeping the wet plant container removable.
scope.user_context: Adult dry-indoor home decor with occasional watering and cleaning.
variants: one nominal 60-65 mm nursery-pot launch size within 140 x 130 x 85 mm

interfaces.name: CAD-owned sleeve cavity to removable nursery pot

evidence.uncertainty_note: The 65 x 60 mm research cavity is a nominal concept only. No physical host pot, taper, rim, feet or drainage pattern has been measured.

failure_modes.mode: Pot does not seat or cannot be removed
failure_modes.effect: Product is unusable or traps the wet pot
failure_modes.mitigation: Measure the exact host pot and keep cavity diameter, taper, rim and floor clearance parametric.

failure_modes.mode: Drainage water pools unseen in the sleeve
failure_modes.mitigation: Provide an inspectable vent/drain path and qualify it by a water-path test.
Physically test the declared pot with wet substrate at controlled tilt angles.

acceptance_criteria: Declared host pot seats and removes by hand without sticking.
Water-path test leaves no hidden pooled water in the sleeve.
Loaded assembly passes the declared tip-stability test.

criticality.rationale: Failure is expected to cause limited property damage, plant loss or a small spill, not a safety-critical event.

decision.rationale: Proceed with own reference generation and the organic cat preform. Keep the host-pot cavity and drainage path in CAD and block manufacture/release until the exact pot and physical tests are documented.

warnings.message: The owned geometry-only Step1X fork is technically cleared only for new post-cutoff runs; image-generator rights remain a product-local warning.
The nominal 65 x 60 mm research cavity is not a measured interface and cannot support a compatibility claim.
The launch scope is a removable-pot sleeve, not a vessel that directly contains soil or water.

next_actions.action: Generate and archive an own transparent curled-cat reference and a post-cutoff geometry-only Step1X run.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Prompt, input hash, runtime provenance and raw GLB are product-local.

next_actions.action: Measure the exact nursery pot and reconstruct the cavity parametrically.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Diameter, taper, rim, height, feet and drainage pattern are measured with method and uncertainty.

next_actions.action: Run host-fit, water-path and tip-stability physical tests.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The declared host assembly passes every acceptance criterion.
